# teamrig

> A Claude Code plugin and CLI that runs a team of Claude Code sessions: a shared task register, per-session inboxes, team rules loaded at every start, helpers' included, that win over conflicting local rules unless you keep them, a guard on pushes to protected branches and one on unvetted package runs, an opt-in pass for shell lines that only read, a hold on messages that would wake an idle session at full price, a wake for an idle session when urgent work is handed to it, each session's token use measured against the week's pace, bursts that spend a week's projected surplus once a person starts one, a nudge that keeps the lead deciding and delegating rather than doing the work itself, the owner's decisions brought by the lead in batches, and the lead's daily meeting with the owner, its agenda gathered in one call.

## Guide

- [teamrig guide](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/SKILL.md): start here: the model, which session you are, where files live, the daily loop
- [Commands](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/commands.md): every command with its flags, an example and its output, the token budget and bursts included
- [Tasks, inbox, checks, plans and skills](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/tasks.md): task fields (a plain-words description of what and why among them), statuses (closing one names its follow-up tasks) and the dependency tree, when work is its own task or a step of one, inbox lines and messages, check flags, week plans, skill rules
- [Workflows](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/workflows.md): a work block, handing work over, waiting (on a peer's work by its task), shipping a change, closing a task, a handover, a lead checkpoint, a lesson turned into a fix, the owner's daily meeting
- [Hooks and permissions](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/hooks.md): what each hook injects or blocks (the team rules a helper starts with, the live task list, with the tasks waiting on the session, after a refresh or a compaction, a helper or session sent back once to a skill edit Claude Code refused), what the mod runs in a tab (/teamrig <command> with no model turn, the refresh's /clear, /reload-plugins after an install, the wake on urgent work), and the permission modes tested
- [Errors and refusals](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/errors.md): what teamrig prints when it stops, and the fix
- [Requirements](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/requirements.md): Claude Code, Node.js, git, terminals, the status line, operating systems, and the check that says what is missing

## Design

- [How it works](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): the design, the files, updating the plugin
- [Keep it safe](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/guides/keep-it-safe.md): the guards on pushes, skipped hooks, unvetted packages and secrets, privileged commands a reviewer approves, reads without a prompt
- [Run your day](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/guides/run-your-day.md): the owner's daily meeting and its decision cards, a question that never stops a session, no prompt while nobody answers, notes between sessions, waking on urgent work
- [Recover from a crash or a full context](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/guides/recover.md): sessions a crash or a reboot killed reopened by `teamrig restore run` in their folder (never one closed on purpose), at each logon on Windows; a fresh context at a task boundary from the session's handover; the turn log of each session's prompts and replies
- [Plan the week](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/guides/plan-the-week.md): the week plan, task sizes in % of the weekly limit and what fits, the daily budget against the week's pace line, holds and lifts, pausing by priority on a short day, bursts that spend a surplus or meet a deadline
- [Grow the team](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/guides/grow-the-team.md): setting up a team from one tab (the `team-setup` skill, a setup backup and scan, a tab per session), session names, temporary hires and their retire, child teams under the lead made with `team split`
- [Ship from many sessions](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/guides/ship-from-many-sessions.md): builds and test runs one at a time under the host lock (`teamrig queue`), merging a branch by a push or a merge command (`teamrig merge`), deploying it past the team's checks (`teamrig deploy`), the queue cutoff and the reset blackout, deploy freezes and the stable periods to measure in, the deploy state in one read
- [Make it improve itself](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/guides/improve-itself.md): a procedure kept as a skill, the limits `teamrig check` holds skills to, the skills scorecard of loads and missed uses (`teamrig skills scorecard`), a refused skill edit sent back, team rules, settling local rules that override the core rules (`teamrig rules scan`, `rules keep`, `rules clear`), a lean setup (`teamrig setup scan`)
- [GitHub sync](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/docs/github-sync.md): reading GitHub issues into the task list: repositories, their sessions, a read-only token per owner, the automatic sync every 15 minutes, and each failure's fix
- [Team config schema](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/config.schema.json): every key a team config may hold

## Optional

- [teamrig-pane guide](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig-pane/blob/main/plugins/teamrig-pane/skills/teamrig-pane-guide/SKILL.md): the task pane plugin that shows a session's tasks beside the conversation
